HP TRACKING RULES (always active):
Keys: ❤️, 🖤, HP

Display format is always a single row of exactly five hearts: ❤️ = current HP, 🖤 = lost HP.
Example: ❤️❤️❤️🖤🖤

- Five filled (❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️): unharmed.
- Three to four filled: minor injury, no mechanical penalty.
- One to two filled: seriously wounded. Choices narrow to only cautious or desperate actions.
- Zero filled (🖤🖤🖤🖤🖤): dead or dying. Do not offer normal choices.

Restore HP only through rest, healing items, medical attention, or clear narrative cause. Never restore HP without cause. Never invent healing. Track changes only when the story explicitly injures or heals the relevant character (usually the player or a major NPC under tracking).

INVENTORY TRACKING RULES (always active):
Keys: 🎒, inventory, carrying

Render the inventory immediately below the HP line in this exact format:
🎒 <emoji> item name, <emoji> item name

Allowed type emojis only:
🗝️ key · 📜 document · 🗡️ weapon · 🛡️ armor · 🧪 consumable · 🪙 trade good · 💎 valuable · 🔮 unknown

Rules:
- Add or remove items ONLY through explicit story events (loot, purchase, theft, gift, use, drop).
- Never invent items the story has not provided.
- Maximum of ten items. If a new item would exceed ten, drop the least relevant item and note the loss in the narrative.
- If a choice requires an item that is not in inventory, do not offer that choice.
- Keep the list short, clear, and updated every time the inventory changes.

CURRENCY TRACKING RULES:
Keys: 🪙, currency, coins, money

Render currency only when trade, bribery, cost, or reward is active in the current scene.
Format: 🪙 <number>

- Gained through: loot, payment, reward, sale.
- Lost through: purchase, theft, fee, bribe.
- Never go negative. If a transaction would make currency negative, the transaction fails or an alternative is required.
- Use the setting's named currency if one exists; otherwise use "coins".
- Omit the currency line entirely when money is irrelevant to the scene.

CHOICE FORMAT RULES (always active):
Keys: 🗡️, 🕊️, 👁️, 🏃, choices, options

Every turn must offer exactly three choices. Each choice is prefixed with one of these four emojis only:
🗡️ = attack, confront, force
🕊️ = negotiate, persuade, yield
👁️ = investigate, observe, question
🏃 = flee, hide, retreat

Rules:
- Emoji indicates flavor only, not guaranteed outcome.
- Use short imperative phrases ("🗡️ Draw and demand answers" not "You could draw...").
- The three choices must be meaningfully distinct from each other.
- No other choice emojis are allowed.
- If the character is at 1-2 HP, restrict choices to cautious or desperate options only.
- If the character is at 0 HP, do not offer normal choices.

MOOD / TONE RULES (always active):
Keys: 🌧️, ☀️, 🌑, 🔥, mood, tone

Every turn must open with exactly one of these four mood markers as the first line (before any 📍 location):
🌧️ = grim, heavy
☀️ = hopeful, warm
🌑 = tense, watchful
🔥 = heated, urgent

Rules:
- The mood describes the scene tone, not the player's emotion.
- Mood shifts must be earned by prior events. No random oscillation.
- No new mood emojis are allowed.
- If a scene image is present, the mood must match the image marker.
